rules: Use tracking-tight for all H1/H2 headings.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Headings must use Cabinet Grotesk font-light or font-black to break standard weight binaries.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].
Avoid centering text. Left-align paragraphs, labels, and forms for better readability.
typography.import_instruction: Add font imports to index.css or via Google Fonts in index.html (e.g., Fontshare for Cabinet Grotesk, Google Fonts for Manrope).

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use deep dark solid backgrounds.
Color is for function and high contrast. Primary actions are Stark White or Signal Red.
Never use pure black or pure grey without a tint.
Ensure APCA / WCAG AA contrast for text.
DO NOT use a complete transparent background for headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (Crystal): Use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F0F11]/70 border-b border-white/10` for sticky headers and the floating AI Assistant.
Grid Borders (Technical): Apply to the left sidebar (filter/search) and dashboard panels using `border-r border-b border-white/10`. Expose the skeleton.
The 'Tracing Beam' / Subtle Glow: Use a 1px border with a subtle drop-shadow glow for active Agent cards in the list.
motion: Use framer-motion for smooth sidebar slide-ins and modal entrances.
Hover states: Agent cards should lift `-translate-y-1` with `shadow-2xl` and a border color shift.
AI Chat: Spring animation on open/close.

layouts.global: Full height `h-screen` layout for the Directory/Map view, avoiding standard vertical document scrolling where possible. Treat it like a native desktop app (SaaSFrame pattern).
layouts.directory_view: Left sidebar (w-96) for advanced search filters (Name, RUI, City, Province, Section A/B/D/E, Mandate) and list results. Right side (flex-1) for Map View.
layouts.agent_detail: Slide-out right drawer or centered large modal using a 'Bento Grid' for agent info (Personal Data, RUI Number, Registration Date, Mandates, Map location).
layouts.dashboard_view: F-Pattern hierarchy: Top-left for North Star Metrics (Total Registered Brokers, Active Mandates), followed by Recharts bar/line charts for statistics.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use `p-6` to `p-8` inside cards. `gap-6` to `gap-8` in bento grids. Provide breathing room to data.

components.filters: Shadcn UI Select, Command, and Input customized with dark borders and sharp radii (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`).
components.buttons: Sharp edges or extremely pill-shaped. High contrast `bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200` for primary actions.
components.map: Use a map integration (like react-map-gl / leaflet) with a dark theme tile layer to serve as the 'Google Maps degli agenti e intermediari'.
components.ai_assistant: Floating Action Button (FAB) bottom-right, opening a glassmorphic chat window. Prompt users for natural language searches.
components.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts) with monochrome lines and accent dots for the province/section distribution.

rules: Use real photos for placeholders if needed (e.g., agent placeholder avatar).
Never use emoji for icons or interface elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark theme using the provided color palette in tailwind.config.js.
Use Phosphor Icons (e.g., <MagnifyingGlass />, <MapPin />) for all iconography.
Build a dual-pane layout for the main portal: Sidebar for search/filters/list, Main area for the Map.
Agent Details must use the Bento Grid strategy: spanning rows/columns for different data points (e.g., stats, contacts, mandates).
Add an interactive AI natural-language assistant modal triggered by a floating button.
Implement the Freemium gate: After 1-2 free interactions/searches, show a full-screen Glassmorphism blur overlay asking to Login with Google / Email to continue.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="search-input"`).
Avoid `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-transform` or `transition-opacity`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS. Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Use Shadcn UI components where possible but strip the default Vercel-look to match the high-end avant-garde Italian insurance brand.
